name: researcher-research-plan → researcher-research-gather
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign MVP-2 research pack. Fires when the plan-phase researcher terminates with decide(action=gather). Spawns the gather-phase researcher with web_search tooling. No chain.phase_transition.proceed.gather sentinel needed — pack identity replaces the phase-validator gate; the role+decide match IS the structural transition.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-gather
on_enter.prompt:
GATHER phase entry. The plan-phase researcher at loop $entity.instance handed off with decide(action="gather"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the plan's scope + verifiable outcomes. Then use web_search to ground the plan's actor names + integration points in external facts (protocol specifics, framework APIs, library behavior). Accumulate findings in scratchpad per researcher-research-gather/20-iteration-rules.md.

Per ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents do not read the graph; web_search is your only external evidence channel.

Terminate with decide(action="synthesize", reason="<one-sentence summary of evidence accumulated>") when the plan's questions are covered, OR decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<why web_search could not resolve the plan's question>") when external evidence is structurally insufficient.

metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/04-phase-transition-to-gather.json — same forward edge, no phase-validator sentinel.
